heading: top-left
name: 靠左標題＋延伸到右緣的直式圖片卡片輪播
desc: 上方靠左一個標題貼齊區塊上緣，下方是一排直式圖片項目的橫向輪播，左側只留很小邊距、右側延伸到畫面右緣並裁切最後一個項目；每個項目的標題疊在圖片左上。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方不留白，標題貼齊區塊的上緣。區塊上方靠左放標題組，標題組只有一個標題（可多行），沒有小標籤、說明文字或按鈕；標題明顯小於下方項目的圖片高度。標題組下方是輪播：多個項目橫向排成一列，不對齊頁面內容寬度，左側只留很小的邊距、接近畫面左緣，右側延伸到畫面右緣，最右側的項目被畫面邊緣裁切、只露出一小部分，提示可繼續往右切換；桌機一次完整露出約五個項目，每個約佔畫面寬的六分之一。每個項目是一張直式圖片，所有項目等寬等高、圖片同一比例；項目的標題疊在圖片內的左上角。輪播沒有可見的箭頭或分頁點，以橫向拖曳或滑動切換。
tablet: 平板沿用桌機版，一次露出的項目數量減少，右側仍露出下一個項目的一部分並延伸到畫面右緣。
mobile: 改為橫向滑動，邊緣露出下一個項目的一部分：標題仍在上方靠左，區塊上方不留白；輪播左側只留很小的邊距，一次完整露出一個項目，約佔畫面寬的一半多，右側露出下一個項目的大部分，延伸到畫面右緣並被裁切。項目內的組成不變，標題仍疊在圖片左上角。可用手指左右滑動切換。

en.name: Left-aligned heading + portrait image card carousel bleeding to the right edge
en.desc: A single left-aligned title right against the top of the section, with a horizontal carousel of portrait image items below; it keeps only a very small left margin while the right side extends to the right edge of the screen and crops the last item. Each item's title sits over the top-left of its image.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The section has no spacing above: the title sits right against the top edge of the section. Place the heading group at the top, aligned left. The heading group contains only a title (may wrap to multiple lines), with no label, description or button. The title is noticeably smaller than the height of the item images below. Below the heading group is a carousel: multiple items in a single horizontal row, not aligned to the page content width; its left side keeps only a very small margin, close to the left edge of the screen, and its right side extends to the right edge of the screen, so the rightmost item is cropped by the screen edge and only a small part of it shows, hinting that more can be scrolled to the right. On desktop about five items are fully visible at a time, each taking about one sixth of the screen width. Each item is a single portrait image; all items are equal in width and height and the images share the same proportion. Each item's title is overlaid inside the image at its top-left corner. The carousel has no visible arrows or pagination dots and is switched by dragging or swiping horizontally.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout, with fewer items visible at a time; part of the next item still shows on the right, extending to the right edge of the screen.
en.mobile: The carousel becomes horizontally swipeable, with part of the next item showing at the edge: the title stays at the top, aligned left, with no spacing above the section; the carousel keeps only a very small margin on the left, one item is fully visible at a time, taking a little over half the screen width, while most of the next item shows on the right, extending to the right edge of the screen and cropped by it. The composition of each item stays the same, with the title still overlaid at the top-left corner of the image. Items can be switched by swiping left and right.
